mapper.sql: s.id as step_id, t.id as task_id, t.account_id, t.avatar_version_id, t.source_file_id, f.object_key as source_object_key, s.action_code, s.attempt_no, s.lease_epoch, json_unquote(json_extract(t.service_snapshot, '$.modelId')) as model_id, json_unquote(json_extract(t.service_snapshot, '$.parameters')) as parameters
mapper.select: select from p_generation_step s join p_generation_task t on t.id = s.task_id and t.account_id = s.account_id join p_file f on f.id = t.source_file_id and f.account_id = t.account_id and f.status = 'AVAILABLE' where s.account_id = #{accountId} and s.task_id = #{taskId} and s.status = 'READY' and s.step_type = 'GENERATE_ACTION' and t.status in ('QUEUED', 'PROCESSING') order by s.created_at limit 1 for update skip locked

select from p_generation_step s join p_generation_task t on t.id = s.task_id and t.account_id = s.account_id join p_file f on f.id = t.source_file_id and f.account_id = t.account_id and f.status = 'AVAILABLE' where s.account_id = #{accountId} and s.task_id = #{taskId} and s.id = #{stepId} and s.lease_owner = #{workerId} and s.lease_epoch = #{leaseEpoch} and s.lease_expires_at > utc_timestamp(3) for update
mapper.update: update p_generation_task set status = 'PROCESSING', internal_state = 'RUNNING', started_at = coalesce(started_at, utc_timestamp(3)), updated_at = utc_timestamp(3) where account_id = #{accountId} and id = #{taskId} and status = 'QUEUED'
mapper.insert: insert into p_generation_attempt (id, created_at, updated_at, account_id, task_id, step_id, attempt_no, lease_epoch, provider_request_key, model_id, status, request_hash) values (#{id}, utc_timestamp(3), utc_timestamp(3), #{claim.accountId}, #{claim.taskId}, #{claim.stepId}, #{claim.attemptNo}, #{claim.leaseEpoch}, #{providerRequestKey}, #{claim.modelId}, 'PREPARED', #{requestHash})
mapper.update: update p_generation_attempt set status = #{status}, provider_request_id = coalesce(#{providerRequestId}, provider_request_id), error_code = #{errorCode}, submitted_at = case when #{status} = 'SUBMITTED' then coalesce(submitted_at, utc_timestamp(3)) else submitted_at end, completed_at = case when #{status} in ('UNKNOWN','FAILED') then utc_timestamp(3) else completed_at end, updated_at = utc_timestamp(3) where id = #{attemptId} and step_id = #{stepId} and attempt_no = #{attemptNo} and lease_epoch = #{leaseEpoch}

update p_generation_step set status = 'READY', error_code = #{errorCode}, lease_owner = null, lease_expires_at = null, heartbeat_at = utc_timestamp(3), updated_at = utc_timestamp(3) where account_id = #{accountId} and task_id = #{taskId} and id = #{stepId} and lease_owner = #{workerId} and lease_epoch = #{leaseEpoch} and lease_expires_at > utc_timestamp(3) and status = 'RUNNING' and not exists (select 1 from p_generation_attempt a where a.step_id = p_generation_step.id and a.attempt_no = p_generation_step.attempt_no and a.lease_epoch = p_generation_step.lease_epoch)

update p_generation_step s set status = 'READY', error_code = #{errorCode}, lease_owner = null, lease_expires_at = null, heartbeat_at = utc_timestamp(3), updated_at = utc_timestamp(3) where s.account_id = #{accountId} and s.task_id = #{taskId} and s.status = 'RUNNING' and s.lease_expires_at <= utc_timestamp(3) and not exists (select 1 from p_generation_attempt a where a.step_id = s.id and a.attempt_no = s.attempt_no and a.lease_epoch = s.lease_epoch)

update p_generation_task set status = 'FAILED', internal_state = 'FINISHED', finished_at = utc_timestamp(3), updated_at = utc_timestamp(3) where account_id = #{accountId} and id = #{taskId} and status in ('QUEUED', 'PROCESSING')

update p_generation_step set status = 'SUCCEEDED', result_file_id = #{fileId}, result_metadata = cast(#{metadata} as json), lease_expires_at = null, heartbeat_at = utc_timestamp(3), updated_at = utc_timestamp(3) where account_id = #{accountId} and task_id = #{taskId} and id = #{stepId} and lease_owner = #{workerId} and lease_epoch = #{leaseEpoch} and lease_expires_at > utc_timestamp(3)

update p_generation_attempt set status = 'SUCCEEDED', output_file_id = #{fileId}, completed_at = utc_timestamp(3), updated_at = utc_timestamp(3) where id = #{attemptId} and step_id = #{stepId} and attempt_no = #{attemptNo} and lease_epoch = #{leaseEpoch}
mapper.select: select count(*) from p_generation_step where account_id = #{accountId} and task_id = #{taskId} and status != 'SUCCEEDED'

select id, account_id, event_id, event_type, trace_id, payload from p_outbox where (status = 'PENDING' and (next_run_at is null or next_run_at <= utc_timestamp(3))) or (status = 'SENDING' and lease_expires_at <= utc_timestamp(3)) order by id limit 1 for update skip locked
mapper.update: update p_outbox set status = 'SENDING', lease_owner = #{workerId}, lease_expires_at = date_add(utc_timestamp(3), interval 5 minute), attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, updated_at = utc_timestamp(3) where id = #{id} and (status = 'PENDING' or (status = 'SENDING' and lease_expires_at <= utc_timestamp(3)))

update p_outbox set status = 'SENT', published_at = utc_timestamp(3), lease_expires_at = null, updated_at = utc_timestamp(3) where id = #{id} and status = 'SENDING' and lease_owner = #{workerId} and lease_expires_at > utc_timestamp(3)
